test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Please turn off the lights ________ leaving the house.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. before .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a directive that emphasizes turning off the lights before leaving the house.
 
• The word **"before"** is the most appropriate option as it indicates a time sequence where the action of turning off the lights should happen prior to leaving the house.
 
• Other options such as **"between"**, **"during"**, and **"amid"** do not logically fit the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Please turn off the lights **before** leaving the house*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Prepositions:**

 
 
• **Between:** Refers to an intermediate point or interval. Example: The meeting is scheduled between 2 PM and 3 PM.
 
• **During:** Indicates a time span in which an action occurs. Example: Please remain seated during the performance.
 
• **Amid:** Refers to being surrounded by or in the middle of. Example: She remained calm amid the chaos.
